channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [8] Reversible layered/non-layered phase transition in a topological semimetal
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Jiadong Zhou, Shoujun Zheng

Authors: Qingrong Liang, Jiali Chen, Zhaoyang Xie, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Topological semimetal phase transition study with direct relevance to electronic structure.

Tags: #topologicalsemimetal #phasetransition #PtBi2

Abstract: Phase transitions in layered materials can differ significantly from those in non-layered materials. Here, the authors demonstrate a reversible phase transition between layered and non-layered phases in the semimetal PtBi2, resulting in a layered/non-layered topological phase transition.
